title: Follow the zkRabbit
tagline: Follow the zkRabbit is an innovative and decentralized social adventure game built on the MINA protocol using zkApps (snarkyJS)
description: "Follow the zkRabbit" is an innovative and decentralized blockchain-powered adventure game that takes players on an enthralling journey through captivating virtual landscapes. Built on the revolutionary MINA protocol, the game leverages the power of zkApps (snarkyJS) to deliver a unique gaming experience that combines blockchain technology, cryptography, and social interaction.
how_its_made:
+ The game harnesses the privacy and scalability features of MINA zkApps, ensuring that players' interactions and cryptographic proofs remain confidential and secure. 

Planned but not implemented:
- XMTP Messaging: Players can stay connected and cooperate with each other using the XMTP protocol for encrypted messaging and real-time communication.
- PUSH Chat: A real-time messaging protocol that enables encrypted and instant communication between users
- Airstack Social Media: The game allows players to link their in-game usernames with their social media profiles via Airstack, fostering social interaction
- The Graph: Subgraphs empower "Follow the zkRabbit" blockchain game with efficient and indexed access to on-chain data
